page.overview:
Who is Mrs. Norris?

Mrs Norris was the pet cat of Argus Filch, the caretaker of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Mrs Norris was described as having an unusually strong connection with her master, alerting him to any students misbehaving inside the school castle.

She was described as appearing almost the same way as Filch. She had bulging yellow, lamp-like eyes, a scrawny, skeletal body and dust-coloured fur.

Mrs Norris was born sometime prior to 1984, and became the pet cat of the Hogwarts school caretaker, Argus Filch. She formed an unusually strong bond with her owner, and often alerted him to any misbehaving students almost instantly. Because of this, she along with Filch were widely loathed by most of the Hogwarts students, and many students' dearest ambition was to "give her a good kick".

During the 1984–1985 school year, first-years Rowan Khanna and Jacob's sibling encountered Mrs Norris while they were assessing entering a locked room at Hogwarts. She hissed at them, and went to find Filch, so the two fled to their common room before they could be caught. Jacob's sibling later cooked up a plan to enter the locked room with Rowan and another friend of theirs, by learning the Sleeping Draught from their friend Penny Haywood and using the potion to subdue Mrs Norris. Mrs Norris drank the Sleeping Draught left in a pool outside the room and immediately fell asleep, allowing the students undisturbed entry into the locked room.
